title: Italian Pilaf with Seed Crusted Veggies
description: A flavorful Italian pilaf dish loaded with seed crusted vegetables, a perfect side dish for any Italian meal.
instructions: Cut the Canadian bacon into small pieces and place on a baking sheet for crusting.
Mix the poppy seeds and a pinch of salt and pepper on a plate.
Roll the Canadian bacon pieces in the seed mixture to coat.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the seed crusted Canadian bacon pieces and sear until golden brown.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the Canadian bacon.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Garnish with additional poppy seeds and serve hot.
